title: Lake Louise Banff Tour from Calgary Canmore Banff
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
While the beauty of these lakes speaks for itself, your tour is designed to make the experience seamless, insightful, and truly memorable:
• Stress-Free Access to the Icons: Forget the crowds, the traffic, and the impossible parking! Moraine Lake is closed to private vehicles for most of the year, but with this tour, you get guaranteed, comfortable, and easy access.
• Expert Storytelling: This isn't just a drive; it's a moving classroom. Our professional, certified guide will transform the scenery with captivating stories of local history, the incredible geology that creates those brilliant turquoise colors, and the tales of the early mountaineers who explored this wild land..
• The Perfect Photo Opportunities: We'll take you directly to the best viewpoints, including the iconic Rockpile at Moraine Lake, to capture the views that were once featured on the Canadian twenty-dollar bill.
• Comfort and Convenience: Sit back, relax, and enjoy the scenery in absolute comfort.
